tools.name: notes_list
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: Lists notes in a notebook, newest first, with id, title and version. Use this when you need a note id. Do not use it to read note bodies; use notes_get.

tools.name: notes_get
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: Returns one note with its body and current version. Use this before notes_update so the update carries the version you read.

tools.name: notes_search
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Full-text search across all notebooks. Use this when the user remembers words from a note but not where it is.

response_format.description: concise returns ids and titles; detailed adds snippets

tools.name: notes_create
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: Creates a note in a notebook and returns its id and version. Use this when the user asks to save something new. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the first note instead of a duplicate.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key; repeats with the same key return the first result

tools.name: notes_update
tools.title: Update note
tools.description: Changes only the fields you send, and only if the note still has expected_version. Use this when editing an existing note. A retry after success fails with a conflict, so it never applies twice.

tools.name: notes_delete
tools.title: Delete note
tools.description: Deletes a note if it still has expected_version. Use this only when the user asks to delete a note. With dry_run true it only reports what would be deleted. A retry after success answers not found.
